title: Validated Temperature
prompt: Create a class Temperature with a celsius property. The setter must raise ValueError for values below -273.15 (absolute zero). Reading celsius returns the stored value.

tests.name: accepts valid values
tests.code:
t = Temperature(25)
assert t.celsius == 25
t.celsius = -10
assert t.celsius == -10
tests.hint: Store in _celsius via the property setter.

tests.name: rejects below absolute zero
tests.code:
import unittest
try:
    Temperature(-300)
    failed = False
except ValueError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: The setter must raise ValueError below -273.15.

tests.name: rejects bad reassignment too
tests.code:
t = Temperature(0)
try:
    t.celsius = -999
    failed = False
except ValueError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: Assignment goes through the same setter as __init__.
